scope: Instructor communication, Oct 2026. Missing documentation is not a request to deliberately reproduce a fault.

questions.title: Machine identity
questions.question: What are the serial number, actual build year, control-box revision and installed SB3 version?
questions.answer: Alpha control box Model 10372; SB3 version 3.8.70; control-box firmware 224. The reference photographs show this HÍ machine.
questions.remaining: Build year unknown; instructor estimate 2022/23. Unique equipment identifiers are omitted from this public edition.

questions.title: Motors and mounts
questions.question: What do the four motor labels say (ASM98/ARM98 or another model), and are the X-motor mounts spring-loaded or fixed?
questions.answer: Motor model ARM98AC-T7.2, confirmed by instructor and photographed nameplate.
questions.remaining: X-motor mount arrangement (spring-loaded or fixed) remains unconfirmed.

questions.title: Spindle and collets
questions.question: What is the spindle make/model and rated power? Which collet family, nut type and manufacturer-specified tightening torque apply, and which collet sizes are stocked?
questions.answer: HSD AT/MT 1073-140. Nameplate: 3 kW/4 hp S6, 220 V three-phase, 300 Hz, 18,000 rpm, 13 A. Collet system: ER25.
questions.remaining: Which ER25 nut is fitted (mini-nut, 29 ft·lb, or E-type, 95 ft·lb, per the ShopBot maintenance schedule) and the stocked collet sizes remain unconfirmed. Nameplate rpm is not proven maximum speed; S6 is not an S1 continuous-power claim.

questions.title: Spindle controller and start sequence
questions.question: What is the VFD make/model? Is there any additional RUN-button step on that unit, or is the documented pendant-START sequence the complete lab sequence? RPM entry plus Enter is already documented.
questions.answer: Yaskawa V1000, CIMR-VU2A0020GAA. Full sequence: on-screen prompt “Press START on control before pressing OK” → pendant START → verify spindle running at commanded speed → on-screen OK → cutting begins. No separate VFD RUN step is part of the described sequence.

questions.title: Z travel and clearance
questions.question: What are the actual usable Z stroke and clearance under the gantry on this machine?
questions.remaining: Usable Z stroke and gantry clearance remain unconfirmed.

questions.title: Warm-up and records
questions.question: Is the installed C5 warm-up the standard routine or a local variant? Where is the machine/hour/fault log, and what should students record?
questions.answer: C5 warm-up is the standard routine.
questions.remaining: No machine/hour/fault log currently exists; a proposal is being drafted separately.

questions.title: Physical home position
questions.question: Where are the X/Y homing switches and the resulting C3 home relative to the table/spoilboard corner? What fixed offsets, if any, are configured? This is not the job origin set by Z2.
questions.remaining: Physical home locations and configured offsets remain unconfirmed.

questions.title: Machine settings
questions.question: Is the correct PRSalpha 144-60 settings profile already loaded on the teaching PC? Students should not reload it.
questions.answer: Correct settings are already loaded on the control PC. CAM is mostly Autodesk Fusion; instructor calls the post “openSPB”, corresponding to the official ShopBot OpenSBP post. Manual setup checks are used.

questions.title: E-stop release
questions.question: Does the installed E-stop release by twisting or pulling? The blue pendant Reset button and its identity are no longer unanswered.
questions.answer: The pendant E-stop releases by twisting. The wall-mounted pendant E-stop, by the monitor, is currently the only E-stop; the red-and-yellow device on the control cabinet is a rotary disconnect, not an E-stop. More E-stops are planned after the move to Fab Lab Saga.

questions.title: Dust collector control
questions.question: Is the collector switched manually, or automatically through output 4/a relay? This is about the switch sequence, not hose bonding.
questions.answer: Dust collector is switched manually at the collector itself.

questions.title: Shutdown and key storage
questions.question: What shutdown order should the lab use for SB3, control box, spindle controller and collector, and where is the interlock key returned?
questions.answer: Current practice: key is not removed from the machine. Planned change: attach it to the collet-removal wrench; not yet implemented. Record this as reported practice, not as manufacturer-approved isolation.
questions.remaining: No lab shutdown order currently exists; a proposal is being drafted separately. Keep manufacturer spindle-isolation guidance distinct from the current key practice.

questions.title: Screws and clearance
questions.question: Which screw types are permitted, and does the lab prescribe a minimum clearance from toolpaths?
questions.answer: No lab-specific screw specification is imposed. Do not invent an approved screw material or numeric clearance. Screws/clamps must still stay clear of toolpaths.

questions.title: Collet assembly sequence
questions.question: After snapping the collet into the nut, should students insert the bit before or after threading that assembly onto the spindle? The manuals show both; which sequence do you teach?
questions.answer: Both assembly orders accepted. Instructor prefers snapping collet into nut, inserting bit, then threading the assembly onto the spindle.

questions.title: Manual Z zero
questions.question: Do you teach manual ZZ with paper as a feeler, or only the C2 plate routine? If manual zeroing is taught, what fixed jog increment and checking method should be stated?
questions.answer: Always use C2 for Z zero. Manual ZZ/paper-feeler zeroing is not taught as the normal alternative.

questions.title: Local custom commands
questions.question: Are C6, C7 and C9 assigned anything on this PC? If so, what do they do, and should students use them?
questions.answer: No locally customized commands reported. This does not mean built-in C macros are absent or should be removed from posted files.

questions.title: Diagnostic references
questions.question: What is the exact homing/move-off-proximity prompt in this SB3 version, and where can staff see the driver alarm LEDs on this control-box revision? Students are not instructed to open the box.
questions.remaining: Exact move-off-proximity prompt and driver LED locations remain unverified; not a repeated request for the instructor.
